product.ta-alphatronic-p92.summary: The P92 was the 25 MHz 386 that Triumph-Adler offered alongside the Dario 386SX.
product.ta-alphatronic-p92.history: In November 1990 a base configuration was advertised at about DM 15,500. The trade press placed it above the Dario 386SX in price and options.
product.ta-alphatronic-p92.technical.con: It could be expanded for graphics applications. The base configuration had 2 MiB of RAM and a 100 MB drive, with an optional TIGA-compatible adapter.
product.ta-alphatronic-p92.technical.ver: BluMach has no runnable profile for this model.
product.ta-alphatronic-p92.technical.lim: The full technical documentation, board configuration and ROM remain pending.
product.ta-alphatronic-p92.technical.mar: Computerwoche · TA-PCs aus rein deutscher Fertigung · 9 November 1990
